name: Feeding Your Future Summer Camp
what_you_do: Learn how grain becomes flour and baked goods. You tour K-State feed and flour mills, bake labs and agronomy research farms. Industry partners share job options.
who_can_apply: Students going into their sophomore, junior or senior year of high school.
pay_detail: $75 per student in 2027. It covers 4 nights in a K-State residence hall, all meals and a Saturday brunch for up to two guests.
deadline_text: The 2027 camp is June 8 to 12, 2027. Join the interest list on the program page. No sign-up date or deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Join the interest list on the program page. Email kstateag@k-state.edu or call 785-532-5736 with questions.
notes: Each extra brunch guest costs $15. Check the page in spring 2027 for sign-up.
